svg.title: Frequency spread sets local delay precision
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Frequency spread sets local delay precision
Input-oriented phases; a = 0.3 rad, total delay = 5 ns
Error bars: assumed individual 1 SD = 0.02 rad; not fit coverage intervals.
Five frequencies, independent equal-variance Gaussian phase errors
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
